inlines.v: INDECI'SIVE, adjective [in and decisive.] Not decisive; not bringing to a final close or ultimate issue; as an indecisive battle or engagement; an argument indecisive of the question. 1. Unsettled; wavering; vacillating; hesitating; as an indecisive state of mind; an indecisive character.
